description: Turn daily step counts into estimated calories burned using your body weight, with a per-1,000-step breakdown.

faqs.a: It is a rough estimate based on average walking energy cost (about 0.045 kcal per step for a 70 kg person), adjusted for your weight. Actual burn varies with pace, terrain, and fitness.
faqs.q: How accurate is the calorie estimate?

faqs.a: Moving a heavier body costs more energy, so the formula scales calories by your weight relative to a 70 kg reference.
faqs.q: Why does body weight change the result?

faqs.a: No — running burns roughly twice as many calories per step. This tool assumes casual to brisk walking.

howto: Enter your total step count for the day.
Enter your body weight in kilograms.
Press Calculate to see total calories burned.
Check the per-1,000-step value to compare different days.
title: Step to Calorie Converter
